// diagnostic

L0529

State-loop condition reads a mutable header binding without a body write before another turn

What

State-loop condition reads a mutable header binding without a body write before another turn

Why

The condition reads the state loop's header binding, but its body never changes that binding before control can return to the condition

Fix

Use `loop line in io.stdin().lines()` for repeated reads, or stop from the body with `if test { break }`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0529: tests/ui/state_loop_unchanged.stderr.
